messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: container crashlooping on gpu-pool-03 (segfault in runtime_engine.so). Severity: P1. Paging sre-olivia and runtime-jay. https://incidents.redwood/4321234567

sre-olivia: I'm on it. Initial alert shows ~2500 errors/min across pool, ~12% of capacity degraded. Customers on Dedicated clusters A & C seeing elevated 5xx.

runtime-jay: jumping in. Any recent deploys to runtime image?

infra-zoe: Not from infra side in last 2h. kube events show repeated CrashLoopBackOff with ExitCode 139. Node nv-gpu-17 showing oom_kill messages as well.

ml-isha: Crash signature from logs: `SIGSEGV at 0x7f8b4e2c` inside `fused_attn_kernel::compute`. This was first seen after a batch of larger seq-length requests started at ~09:12 UTC.

pager-ben: Noting customer impact: two high-traffic tenants (acct-42, acct-88) reporting timeouts. CS on standby.

support-ana: I've opened tickets for acct-42 and acct-88 and flagged as incident. They're seeing 502s and cached fallbacks firing.

runtime-jay: OK. Hypothesis: recent fused-kernel commit (runt-5.12.3) may be hitting an edge with long sequences + mixed-precision path. Repro attempt on dev: building image with debug symbols and repro harness.

sre-olivia: For mitigation, we should: 1) scale down traffic to affected pool, 2) cordon nv-gpu-17 node, 3) set autoscaler to avoid scheduling new runtime pods there. Can we roll back the runtime image on Dedicated pools?

infra-zoe: Cordon + drain started: `kubectl cordon nv-gpu-17 && kubectl drain nv-gpu-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. Scaling down backend to 60% on pool-03.

runtime-jay: I'm building a hotfix that disables fused path at runtime via env var `RW_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1`. Pushing a canary image to staging and then to pool-03 canary set.

ml-isha: Disabling fused attention reduces perf but should avoid segfaults. Suggest immediate rollout to canary 10% then 100% if green. Also adjust max_sequence to 1024 temporarily.

incident-bot: Deployment initiated by runtime-jay: `canary runtime-image:runt-5.12.3-hotfix` to pool-03-canary at 09:28:22 UTC.

pager-ben: Observability: error-rate on pool-03 dropped from 2500err/min -> 180err/min after canary deploy. Latency up ~20% for some endpoints. Customer fallback reduced.

support-ana: acct-42 reports partial recovery after ~09:35 UTC, still seeing increased latency for long-completion jobs.

runtime-jay: Rolling hotfix to remaining nodes in pool-03. Command: `kubectl set env ds/runtime RW_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1 --namespace=redwood-serving` and bump image. Expect full rollout by 09:45.

infra-zoe: Rollout complete to pool-03 at 09:47 UTC. nv-gpu-17 remains cordoned and under investigation. We collected core dump and mounted fs for retrieval: `/var/crash/core.runtime.4321234567.gz`.

ml-isha: Repro in local env succeeded once with fused path enabled using a long sequence (tokens ~5100) and batch size 4 — triggers same SIGSEGV. With `RW_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1` no crash. Good signal.

sre-olivia: Current customer impact: degraded performance for heavy seqs but no hard outages. Marking status: partial service disruption. Notifying affected customers with ETA for full mitigation.

cs-liam: Sent status updates to acct-42 and acct-88. Offering priority support and temporary rate limits for background jobs.

runtime-jay: Patching plan: revert fused kernel commit in repo -> run full CI -> craft minimal regression test (long-tok stress) -> cherry-pick fix back to main. Opening ticket: https://tracker.redwood/ISSUE-6572.

support-ana: Tickets linked to incident. Customers acknowledged.

incident-bot: Incident severity updated to P2 at 09:56 UTC after mitigation reduced error rate and no new crashloops. Pager handoff to on-call rotation in 30m.

sre-olivia: Actions open: (1) RCA runbook draft, (2) add long-sequence regression to premerge tests, (3) improve safe-fallback env toggles, (4) analyze core dump with ASAN where possible. Assigning owners in tracker.

runtime-jay: Will post stacktrace and minimal repro in the issue. Also recommend telemetry to track kernel use by sequence length going forward.

infra-zoe: Node nv-gpu-17 will remain cordoned until postmortem. We'll repro with mounted core dump and escalate to HW team if needed.

cs-liam: Final note: customers advised of perf hit but stable responses. Keeping them updated during RCA.

sre-olivia: Wrapping up this thread for now. If error rate increases we reopen. Thanks everyone. :heart:
